purpose: Open-license pharmacology education sources to support foundational learning. This is not an approved clinical prescribing knowledge base.
ingestion_policy: Use only entries marked commercial_reuse_permitted for any extracted or adapted content in a commercial product, preserve attribution and license notices, track source versions, and have clinical summaries independently reviewed. Do not use any book as a current drug monograph or patient-specific medication authority.

sources.title: Nursing Pharmacology, 2nd edition
limits: The authors explicitly state this is not intended to be a drug reference book.
Designed for prelicensure nursing education, not dental prescribing decisions.
Any derived clinical card must be reviewed independently by a qualified clinician.
